binding: Resolve syntax names in owning ECMAScript module/function/block environments. Identifier spelling is not a cross-scope/global semantic identity. Member names are property keys, not lexical variables. Import/export bindings connect modules at represented source paths. No alpha renaming.
execution: Interpret each reconstructed production under referenced ECMAScript static/runtime semantics. Propagate Reference and Completion records; preserve short circuit, ordered operand effects, lexical captures, receivers, abrupt exits, await and finalization. No executable branch is deleted merely because a current profile makes it unreachable.

runtimeBoundary.Worker: Node Worker from worker_threads: module URL plus structured workerData; typed shared views retain underlying SharedArrayBuffer sharing; separate isolates and private state; error/exit events and terminate Promise under pinned Node contract.
runtimeBoundary.timers: Node setTimeout/setInterval/clearTimeout/clearInterval. Delay is requested scheduling threshold, not an exact wall-time guarantee; event ordering constrained by Node, not by source listing across agents.
runtimeBoundary.Atomics: All represented operations retain ECMAScript shared-memory/Atomics semantics; no data-race-freedom or unique-work theorem inferred from syntax.
runtimeBoundary.performance: performance.now is external elapsed-time observation; no static cycles or latency assigned.
runtimeBoundary.AbortSignal: Externally supplied cancellation/event object under Node AbortSignal contract. Access and event effects remain calls in native tree.
runtimeBoundary.process: process.execArgv is external launch configuration; source filtering remains represented. Launch flags and scheduling are not guessed.

unknownFamily.carrier: environment traces consistent with pinned Node and ECMAScript agent/shared-memory contracts
exclusions: no timing bound stronger than the runtime guarantees
unknownFamily.downstream: Any candidate depending on cost, overlap, fairness, failure ordering or unqualified memory-policy assumptions remains open until corresponding evidence is supplied.

normalization.claimBoundary: algorithm/control/data effects; excludes byte-identical source introspection and stack-trace formatting; neither is used as performance-discovery evidence
